words/insert-middle-3: Insertion next to a repeated word: the reference matches the later copy, the engine the earlier one. Both alignments cost the same.
words/sentence-rewrite-1: The reference absorbs one equal word between two large changes in a rewritten sentence.
tokens/abbreviation: Equal-cost alignment of abbreviation letters and periods.
paragraphs/swap-1: Adjacent swap: the reference moves the other paragraph of an equal-cost pair.
paragraphs/move-far-6: A move into the last paragraph of a story is recorded as a deletion and an insertion.
paragraphs/move-far-12: A move into the last paragraph of a story is recorded as a deletion and an insertion.
paragraphs/move-far-24: A move into the last paragraph of a story is recorded as a deletion and an insertion.
paragraphs/similarity-80-spread: Equal-cost alignment of scattered single-word changes.
paragraphs/similarity-90-block: Equal-cost alignment of scattered single-word changes.
paragraphs/replace-all-paragraphs: Unrelated paragraphs: the reference keeps a few scattered common words.
lists/bullet-reorder: Adjacent swap: the reference moves the other item of an equal-cost pair.
lists/number-reorder: Adjacent swap: the reference moves the other item of an equal-cost pair.
tables/column-insert: Column changes: the reference keeps the cells and records their content and properties; the engine replaces the rows.
tables/column-delete: Column changes: the reference keeps the cells and records their content and properties; the engine replaces the rows.
tables/grid-span-change: Column changes: the reference keeps the cells and records their content and properties; the engine replaces the rows.
notes/footnote-and-body: Text next to a note reference changes: the reference deletes and recreates the note.
notes/endnote-and-body: Text next to a note reference changes: the reference deletes and recreates the note.
fields/date-format: The reference recomputes DATE field results at compare time. The engine never resolves fields.
fields/field-to-text: The reference recomputes DATE field results at compare time. The engine never resolves fields.
fields/merge-field-name: The reference replaces the paragraph text around a changed merge field.
controls/sdt-inline-text: Inside an inline content control the reference writes the deletion before the insertion.
whole-document/unrelated-1: Unrelated documents: alignment of scattered common words differs.
whole-document/unrelated-3: Unrelated documents: alignment of scattered common words differs.
whole-document/unrelated-4: Unrelated documents: alignment of scattered common words differs.
whole-document/long-200-pages: One equal-cost paragraph alignment in a long document differs.
